listing.name: Naruto: Rise of a Ninja (Naruto Rise Recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Windows package/installer; original game data Limits: Work in progress with possible bugs/crashes/visual issues; new native renderer and legacy fallback differ. Upstream platforms: Windows x86-64 installer/runtime. Other platform presets are explicitly incomplete/unverified rather than established player routes. Original data: Own Naruto: Rise of a Ninja Xbox 360 disc image or extracted full game folder containing default.xex. Upstream installer can import ISO or the launcher can select existing game/. DLC is separate player-supplied content. Reviewed README does not pin accepted region, media ID, executable revision or digest. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
